name: First Sponsor Group Limited
summary: First Sponsor Group Limited, an investment holding company, invests in, develops, and sells residential and commercial properties in the People's Republic of China, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Property Development, Property Investment, Property Financing, and Hotel Operations segments. It provides interest-bearing loans to associates, joint ventures, and third parties.
